hero.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face, or device PIN. No passwords to leak, no codes to type. Your live traffic and policies are one touch away.
hero.footer: Multi-tenant isolation • Real-time Socket updates • Audit-ready logs

login.title: Sign in to Zero Plus
login.subtitle: Enter your work email, then confirm with your passkey.
login.unsupported: This browser doesn't support passkeys. Please use a recent version of Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox.
login.passkeyHint: After you continue, your device will ask for Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello, or your device PIN.
login.lostAccess: Lost access to your device? Contact your organization admin.
login.trustNote: Protected by Zero Plus passwordless authentication

addDevice.title: Add a new device
addDevice.description: Scan this QR code from the device you want to add, then follow the on-screen instructions.
addDevice.step1: Open the camera on the new device and scan the QR code.
addDevice.step2: Follow the on-screen instructions to register your biometrics.
addDevice.step3: Once done, your device list updates automatically.
addDevice.invitePageSubtitle: Register biometrics for your Zero Plus account
addDevice.inviteExpired: This invitation has expired. Please ask for a new QR code.
addDevice.inviteUsed: This invitation has already been used.
addDevice.inviteNotFound: Invitation not found. It may have been deleted or expired.
addDevice.deviceNameHint: A label to identify this device in your profile (max 120 characters).
addDevice.successDesc: You can now sign in to Zero Plus from this device using biometrics.
addDevice.keyNote: Your private key never left this device.
addDevice.privacyNote: Your biometric data never leaves this device. Only a public key is sent to the server.
addDevice.tryAgain: Please go back to your original device and generate a new QR code.
